panels.description: To run this dashboard, start from Usage Stats, selecting the desired user.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  uniq(username) as "Total_Username",
  uniq(origin) as "Total_Origin",
  uniq(apphost) as "Total_EAA_APPS",
  uniq(cloudZone) as "Total_cloudZone",
  uniq(geoCity) as "Total_geoCity",
  uniq(geoCountry) as "Total_geoCountry",
  SUM(bytesIn) "Incoming",
  SUM(bytesOut) "Outgoing",
  uniq(conUuid) as "Total_Connectors"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
  AND username != '-'
  AND apphost != '-'
  and conUuid != '-'  
GROUP BY  d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Users per APP; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT datetime,  99 as v FROM ${table} 
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 

AND (
  urlPath = '/saml/sp/response'
  AND
  idpinfo = 'UNSPEC|D'
  AND
  username != '-'
)

  order by datetime desc
  limit 1
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Last login time; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT count(DISTINCT username) AS querycontroller, 99 as v
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
AND datetime > NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=ActiveUserCount; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  DISTINCT arrayJoin(splitByChar(',', assumeNotNull(groups))) AS Name, 99 as v
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND groups != '-'

ORDER BY datetime DESC
LIMIT 500
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=User Groups ; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT count(DISTINCT username) AS querycontroller, 99 as v
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND datetime > NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=ActiveUserCount; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT sum(bytesIn)*8/60 as Incoming, sum(bytesOut)*8/60 as Outgoing, 
toStartOfInterval(datetime, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS d
--datetime as d
FROM ${table} 
WHERE datetime > (now() - interval 30 minute)
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 
AND username != '-'
GROUP BY d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Near realtime bandwidth usage; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  origin, count() as Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
GROUP BY origin
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 5
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 5 Destinations by hits; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT apphost, count(*) as Total FROM ${table} 
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) 
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 
AND apphost != '-'

group by apphost
order by Total desc
limit 5
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 5 EAA_APP by hits; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  count(*) as "Total"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND idpinfo IN ('LOGIN|F', 'MFA|MF')
GROUP BY  d, denyReason, statusCode
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Failed logins; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  username, denyReason, clientip, datetime
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND idpinfo IN ('LOGIN|F', 'MFA|MF')
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY  username, denyReason, clientip, datetime
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} failed login users list; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  arrayElement(splitByChar(':', ifNull(origin, '')), 2) AS port,
  count(port) AS port_count,
  maxOrNull(datetime) AS Last_Access
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND origin IS NOT NULL
  AND origin != '-'
GROUP BY port
ORDER BY port_count DESC
LIMIT ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} active ports; du=${__user.login}';

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (
    SELECT
        clientVersion, clientId, username, maxOrNull(datetime) AS Last_Access
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE
        clientVersion IS NOT NULL AND clientVersion != '-'
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
        AND ${generalescaping}
        AND $__adHocFilter()
    GROUP BY clientVersion, clientId, username
),
d AS (
    SELECT antiMalwareRunning, firewallStatus, deviceName, deviceId, joinedDomains, mobileDevice, osAutoUpdate, osName, riskPostureTagsName, riskPostureTagsPassed, riskPostureTagsRemediations, riskPostureTiersName, riskPostureTiersPassed, riskPostureTiersRemediations
    FROM ${device_table}
    WHERE $__timeFilter(signalTimestamp) 
)
SELECT
    f.clientVersion, f.clientId, f.username, f.Last_Access,
    d.antiMalwareRunning, d.firewallStatus, d.deviceName, d.joinedDomains, d.mobileDevice, d.osAutoUpdate, d.osName,
    d.riskPostureTagsName, d.riskPostureTagsPassed, d.riskPostureTagsRemediations, d.riskPostureTiersName, d.riskPostureTiersPassed, d.riskPostureTiersRemediations
FROM f
ANY INNER JOIN d ON f.clientId = d.deviceId

SETTINGS 
    hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60, 
    hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Device DP; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS time,
    statusCode,
    count(*) AS "Total"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY time, statusCode
ORDER BY time ASC, statusCode
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Status codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS time,
    errorCode,
    count(*) AS "Total"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY time, errorCode
ORDER BY time ASC, errorCode
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Error codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
    sessionId,
    count(*) AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
  AND sessionId != '-'
GROUP BY  sessionId
ORDER BY Total desc
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} session ID; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT

    httpMethod,
    count(*) AS "Total"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)

       errorCode,
